svg.title: How a request runs
svg.desc: You describe the job in plain words. Each skill description ends with a NOT FOR clause naming its neighbors, so exactly one specialist claims it. That skill loads its references on demand and returns evidence: for suede-seo-audit, A to F lanes and exact fixes.
svg.text: One ask. One specialist. Proof back.

g.text: no two skills claim one job

svg.text: Example: suede-seo-audit. Every skill follows the same path, from a page audit to a multi-agent repo change.
